label: emitDiagnostic is the only funnel for the hook's six diagnostic call sites, so a health-only default is one function and one new persist parameter, not six edits.
writeBoundedJsonl already takes requireDebug and skips the gate only when it is false, so the ungated health path needs a pass-through and no new writer.
A health-only record needs no type change: skillLabel and errorDetails are already optional in the record builder and the validator.
The health section keeps only the last 30 records, so a default flip changes the doctor from over 3 prompts of one debug session to a rolling window of the last 30.
AdvisorStatusOutputSchema and hookHealth are strict, so adding lastRecordAt is a contract change that needs a rebuild and a parse test; iteration 3 rated it zero risk on bytes alone.
advisor-status.vitest.ts already holds the gated hook-health fixture and the absent case, so change 1 and change 3 each add one case to an existing file.
measure-brief-cost.mjs accepts --root for both the corpus and the hook, so a two-row fixture with a stub outage hook proves the refusal path without a daemon.
